lines.speaker: regale
lines.text: Reward: Gem ×50

lines.speaker: regale
lines.text: I can't thank you enough for the sweet potatoes,

lines.speaker: regale
lines.text: but...
What's wrong?

lines.speaker: regale
lines.text: I can't tell you how much we were looking forward to the sweet potatoes you brought us.

lines.speaker: regale
lines.text: We were all dressed up for the occasion, had even busted out the fancy china,

lines.speaker: regale
lines.text: and were just about to take our first bite...

lines.speaker: regale
lines.text: when the A.C.P.U. came barging in!

lines.speaker: regale
lines.text: They said importing food from the surface is illegal,

lines.speaker: regale
lines.text: and confiscated all the sweet potatoes.

lines.speaker: regale
lines.text: Fortunately, since it was only our first offense, all we had to do was pay a fine.

lines.speaker: regale
lines.text: Oh, how wonderfully those precious sweet potatoes looked...

lines.speaker: regale
lines.text: All cooked up nice and proper...

lines.speaker: regale
lines.text: Oh, don't worry.

lines.speaker: regale
lines.text: We didn't mention a word about you, Commander.

lines.speaker: regale
lines.text: We're nothing if not loyal, hehe.

lines.speaker: regale
lines.text: But you should have seen those A.C.P.U. officers.

lines.speaker: regale
lines.text: They were practically chomping at the bit to eat those sweet potatoes.

lines.speaker: regale
lines.text: One in particular was really drooling up a storm. I almost told her to just go ahead and eat them.
Was she, by any chance, petite? And have long, white hair?

lines.speaker: regale
lines.text: Yeah, that was her!

lines.speaker: regale
lines.text: Do you know each other?
Yes. She's a friend of mine, and she's a sweet potato fiend.

lines.speaker: regale
lines.text: Wow.

lines.speaker: regale
lines.text: Sounds like she must be a big fan of food in general.
Probably.

lines.speaker: regale
lines.text: Well, that's a small consolation.

lines.speaker: regale
lines.text: Since she's someone who has a love for food,

lines.speaker: regale
lines.text: she at least won't treat the sweet potatoes disrespectfully.

lines.speaker: regale
lines.text: Anyway, importing food from the surface is a big no-no now.

lines.speaker: regale
lines.text: There must be a legal way around this.

lines.speaker: regale
lines.text: Back to the drawing board!

lines.speaker: regale
lines.text: If I come up with anything,

lines.speaker: regale
lines.text: I'll be in touch.

lines.speaker: regale
lines.text: Thanks again!
